_comment: Module map of this repository (owner decision, 2026-11-20: four modules incl. Internal, which replaced Kit and tools; tests are not a module, each test file follows the code it tests). Same shape as the modules file the cockpit reads (--modules): modules[{id,name,desc}], assign[{path,module,basis?,candidates?,alias?}]. Longest matching path prefix wins (a path ending in '/' is a prefix, otherwise an exact file). module=null is an explicit 'unassigned'; 'candidates' (optional, decision data) lists the modules a file could equally belong to and changes no assignment; 'alias' marks a pseudo-path that is not a tracked file. Test files follow the mirrored source path (tests/tools/test_x.py -> tools/x.py), then an entry for the test path itself. A file that cannot be placed in a sub-module goes to the parent; a file ambiguous between modules stays null and is reported. Guard: tests/tools/test_cardmeta_map.py.

modules.name: Core logic
modules.desc: logic.py (pure rules, parsing, ranking, card views) and cockpit.py (HTTP server, gh calls, caching, actions)

modules.name: Documentation and contracts
modules.desc: docs/: constitution, ADRs, memos, contracts, deployment, screenshots, owner defaults, footprint declarations and this map

modules.name: Internal
modules.desc: what keeps the project and its assistants running, as opposed to the product (template default for every project)

modules.name: Boot-filling
modules.desc: the Dispatcher and Workers runtime (dispatcher/) and its tests

modules.name: Project metadata
modules.desc: this module map, the footprint declaration and the card-metadata collectors (tools/cardmeta_*.py) with their tests

modules.name: DevOps
modules.desc: CI workflows, the kit/ install and policy files for a consuming repository, repository configuration, deploy and runtime settings

modules.name: Agent policies and skills
modules.desc: standing instructions for assistants (CLAUDE.md) and any skill or agent definitions
